steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Configure Android native project environment for CalcPro.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Set up application package name, launcher activity, and theme attributes.

steps.title: Create Color Palette and UI Resources
steps.description: Define modern calculator theme colors, dark slate backgrounds, and vibrant accent hues.

steps.title: Design Calculator Button Shapes
steps.description: Create custom ripple drawables and background shapes for number, operator, and action buttons.

steps.title: Build Calculator Main Layout
steps.description: Construct high-precision layout with expression history display, primary result screen, and responsive keypad grid.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Engine
steps.description: Develop robust math evaluation engine supporting arithmetic, trigonometry, logarithms, percentages, and memory operations.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Connect UI button clicks, handle operator sequencing, maintain calculation history, and update display smoothly.

steps.title: Enable Scientific Mode Toggle
steps.description: Implement expandable scientific keypad row for advanced functions like sin, cos, tan, log, ln, and square root.

steps.title: Validate Responsive UI and Spacing
steps.description: Ensure optimal button sizing, text auto-scaling, and clean padding across diverse screen configurations.

steps.title: Building CalcPro
steps.description: Compile native Android project artifacts and package final APK.
